thread.title: Nasdaq 100 Movers: AMGN, AMD

author: BNK Invest
title: Nasdaq 100 Movers: AMGN, AMD
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Wednesday, shares of Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) topped the list of the day's best performing components of the Nasdaq 100 index, trading up 12.5%. Year to date, Advanced Micro Devices registers a 17.3% gain.
And the worst performing Nasdaq 100 component thus far on the day is Amgen ( AMGN ), trading down 4.6%. Amgen is lower by about 5.8% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Illumina ( ILMN ), trading down 3.9%, and Apple ( AAPL ), trading up 3.7% on the day.
